records.name: Sepp Schräglage
records.biography_en: He considers a sharp turn the only honest answer to a straight question. He navigates HyperNorm discussions by turning before anyone can establish a position. His short wooden ski is an argument for decisive edges. The building calls residents aligned or obstructive; he has begun leaving room for the ones learning to turn. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er nimmt jede Kurve. Geradeaus war nicht ausgeschildert.

variant_notes.note_en: He considers a sharp turn the only honest answer to a straight question.

records.name: Dina Direktabfahrt
records.biography_en: She is annoyed whenever gravity requires additional explanation. She divides the courtyard into downhill and unnecessarily delayed, carrying two poles that have never lost an argument with gravity. A dissonant card proposing a slower route has made her wait beside a neighbour without announcing it as a sacrifice. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie fährt direkt. Rückfragen sind im Gefälle schlecht zu hören.

variant_notes.note_en: She is annoyed whenever gravity requires additional explanation.

records.name: Egon Absprung
records.biography_en: He committed to the jump before checking whether confidence was included. His wooden wedge represents the moment before a decision becomes very difficult to reverse. HyperNorm calls hesitation either caution or cowardice according to seniority. He has begun admitting that the frightened residents are often the most attentive. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Absprung war beschlossen. Die Zustimmung wird noch gesucht.

variant_notes.note_en: He committed to the jump before checking whether confidence was included.

records.name: Lola Langlauf
records.biography_en: She makes steady progress partly to spite the concept of a shortcut. She keeps water and mittens for a route the building promises is almost over. People are classified as progressing or falling behind. A contradictory card about changing pace has made her notice who disappears when the leaders accelerate. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie läuft weiter. Der Abkürzungsantrag wurde zu Recht verdächtig.

variant_notes.note_en: She makes steady progress partly to spite the concept of a shortcut.

records.name: Fritz Furchenamt
records.biography_en: He treats every mogul as evidence of inadequate piste maintenance. He carries a leather boot as proof that the terrain is the defective party. His approved categories are smooth or somebody's responsibility. A dissonant card suggests that adapting might be a skill rather than an admission of defeat. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Hang ist uneben. Der Schuh hat das schriftlich bestätigt.

variant_notes.note_en: He treats every mogul as evidence of inadequate piste maintenance.

records.name: Oskar Obenbleiben
records.biography_en: He enjoys ski touring most when the destination remains negotiable. His rope coil and blank map let him prepare thoroughly without choosing a destination. HyperNorm treats routes as official or wandering. He has quietly marked an unapproved resting place where a tired neighbour can see the valley. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Ziel bleibt offen. Die Ausrüstung ist bereits dagegen versichert.

variant_notes.note_en: He enjoys ski touring most when the destination remains negotiable.
